We put years of practice to work on your skin, hair, and body

Dr. Devi and the Facelit team see you in Kowdiar, Karunagappalli, or Guruvayur. Tell us the concern you want to change. We recommend a plan around it, then call you to confirm a time.

Request a consultation Call now

Your Facelit journey starts with a conversation. Meet our experts and discover a custom treatment plan.

Call now WhatsApp

This form does not confirm an appointment. Our team will get in touch shortly on your registered mobile number.

Our Director

Physician-led care at the heart of Facelit.

Dr. Devi KR

Founder & Director MBBS, MD General Physician — Diabetology, Aesthetic & Cosmetic Medicine, Lifestyle Medicine

Dr. Devi KR is the founder and director of Facelit — a general physician with deep focus in diabetology, aesthetic & cosmetic medicine, and lifestyle medicine. She is dedicated to helping patients stay healthy, look vibrant, and live well.

Known for careful, comprehensive care, she brings medical breadth to every consultation: diabetes and hypertension management, allergy care, aesthetic treatments, and practical lifestyle changes that support lasting results.

At Facelit, Dr. Devi leads with a physician-first philosophy — listening closely, explaining options clearly, and shaping plans that respect both clinical need and personal goals. Whether the focus is metabolic health, skin and aesthetic refinement, or everyday habits that protect long-term wellbeing, her care stays grounded, thoughtful, and personal.

Specializations

  • Diabetology — patient-centered diabetes management, monitoring, and ongoing support tailored to real life.
  • Aesthetic & cosmetic medicine — procedures that enhance appearance with a natural look and a medical standard of care.
  • Lifestyle medicine — preventive habits and sustainable changes that strengthen health beyond the clinic visit.

Stories Shaped By Confidence.
